adapter_layer.rule: a client_measurements row exists only after valid speed in [5,120] km/h and gap filters

eventtrace_layer.label: REAL_MOBILITY_OPPORTUNITY + DETERMINISTIC_DATA_QUALITY + CONTROLLED_OBSERVATION
eventtrace_layer.rule: Complete-aligned controlled Bernoulli p_obs=0.35 on each R=1 unit, seed-specific, method-independent

forbidden_wording: Do not describe controlled p_obs as real-world recorded sensor failure.
